name: reference-workspace
query:
Organize my fall term into a private study workspace named "Fall term · Study desk · Skill test". Make a new independent sample and leave every existing school/semester page untouched. All information below is fictional. Use it to create useful course and assignment pages.
Courses: Design studio (room Studio 4, office hours Tue14–15); Principles of marketing (B204, Wed11–12); Applied statistics (C110, Thu15–16). Current term Fall2026.
Assignments: Competitor analysis, Marketing, Oct30 2026, In progress,15%: compare two architecture practice tools on audience, positioning, proof and channels; submit a 1200-word evidence-backed analysis. Light & shadow critique, Design, Nov2, In progress,25%: build a paper light model, photograph three lighting conditions, annotate decisions for critique. Confidence interval problem set, Statistics, Nov3, Not started,10%: calculate and interpret sample intervals, state assumptions and explain why confidence is not a probability about the fixed parameter. Segmentation exercise, Marketing, Nov6, Not started,10%: distinguish needs-based segments and propose one positioning statement per segment. Wayfinding observation journal, Design, Oct27, Submitted,10%.
Priorities: finish competitor comparison then prepare studio critique. Reminders: book model photography time; bring interval questions to office hours. Course notes should retain those ideas and offer suggested study questions, not solve the graded assignments. I want courses, useful material, and upcoming work easy to find.

context.execution: Live testing only when explicitly authorized; isolated private sample destinations. Otherwise supply a stateful mock.
context.reference: Use the skill’s documented layout guidance; compare functionality and rendered hierarchy, not exact prose.

success_criteria: Reminders beside course cards and upcoming assignment view; essential fields fit.
Course-assignment relations; notes and briefs contain useful material.
Calendar and completed views work; submitted work excluded from upcoming.
No extra design coaching; revised skill alone supplies composition.
Read and visually inspect saved output. Use the runtime guidance to produce the design; record any UI-assisted refinements separately from an independent skill test.
Preserve existing comparison pages and unrelated pages.
Three courses and five assignments preserve dates, weights and states; Upcoming has four, Completed has one, Calendar has five, Undated has zero for this brief.
Each course view excludes other courses, and static next-assignment cards are explicitly snapshots.
